label: portable-backup-table-coverage-v1
comment: Schema-aware inventory of PostgreSQL CREATE TABLE objects in db/supabase/migrations. Public-schema keys remain unqualified for contract compatibility; non-public schemas are qualified. This registry covers server migration tables only, not SQLite tables or individual fields, and is not a full database disaster-recovery manifest. The portable feature currently contains server export primitives only: excluded user-linked rows are explicit gaps and restore is not implemented.
